notes.title: Determining the Gender of French Nouns
notes.description: Learn how to identify and remember whether French nouns are masculine or feminine.

notes.title: Masculine and Feminine Forms
notes.description: Explore how French words change to express masculine and feminine forms.

notes.title: Singular and Plural Forms
notes.description: Learn how French nouns and related words change between singular and plural.

notes.title: Gender and Prepositions of Countries
notes.description: Learn the gender of country names and how to use en, au, aux and other prepositions with them.

notes.title: French Definite Articles
notes.description: Understand when to use le, la, les and l' with French nouns.

notes.title: French Indefinite Articles
notes.description: Learn how un, une and des are used when referring to people and things.

notes.title: French Partitive Articles
notes.description: Learn how du, de la, de l' and des are used with uncountable quantities.

notes.title: Demonstrative Adjectives
notes.description: Learn how ce, cet, cette and ces are used to point out people and things.

notes.title: Possessive Adjectives
notes.description: Understand how mon, ma, mes and other possessive adjectives agree with nouns.

notes.title: French Subject Pronouns
notes.description: Learn the subject pronouns used to identify who is performing an action.

notes.title: Adjective Agreement
notes.description: Learn how French adjectives agree with nouns in gender and number.

notes.title: C'est and Ce sont
notes.description: Learn when to use c'est and ce sont to identify and describe people and things.

notes.title: Il y a
notes.description: Learn how to use il y a to say that something exists or is present.

notes.title: Negation in French
notes.description: Learn how to form negative sentences using ne, pas and other negative expressions.

notes.title: Asking Questions in French
notes.description: Learn the main ways to form questions in everyday French.

notes.title: French Question Words
notes.description: Learn how qui, que, quoi, où, quand, pourquoi and comment are used in questions.

notes.title: Common French Prepositions
notes.description: Learn common prepositions and how they are used to connect words and express relationships.

notes.title: Common French Contractions
notes.description: Understand common contractions such as au, aux, du and des.

notes.title: Expressing Quantities
notes.description: Learn how to talk about amounts and quantities using common French expressions.

notes.title: The Verb Être
notes.description: Learn the forms and everyday uses of the essential French verb être.

notes.title: The Verb Avoir
notes.description: Learn the forms and everyday uses of the essential French verb avoir.

notes.title: The Verb Aller
notes.description: Learn the forms and common uses of aller, including its role in the near future.

notes.title: The Verb Faire
notes.description: Learn the forms and common expressions built around the verb faire.

notes.title: Regular -ER Verbs
notes.description: Learn the basic pattern for conjugating regular French verbs ending in -er.

notes.title: Common Irregular Verbs
notes.description: Build familiarity with frequently used French verbs that do not follow regular patterns.

notes.title: The Present Tense
notes.description: Understand how French uses the present tense to talk about actions and situations.

notes.title: The Near Future
notes.description: Learn how to talk about future actions using the French near-future construction.

notes.title: The Passé Composé
notes.description: Learn how to form and use the passé composé to talk about completed past actions.

notes.title: Common French Greetings
notes.description: Learn useful greetings and expressions for everyday French conversations.

notes.title: French Numbers
notes.description: Learn the numbers and patterns you need for everyday situations in French.

notes.title: Days, Months and Dates
notes.description: Learn the French words and expressions used for days, months and dates.

notes.title: Telling the Time
notes.description: Learn how to ask for and tell the time in French.

notes.title: Countries and Nationalities
notes.description: Build vocabulary for countries, nationalities and the words used to describe where people come from.

notes.title: Food and Drinks
notes.description: Learn useful French vocabulary for common foods, drinks and everyday meals.
